title: Savta ben Alem
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 64a: he worshipped Pe’or unwittingly. Hyman says it is not known whether he was a Torah scholar. (Hyman reports Rashi’s explanation of Alem as a place-name.)[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading and Rashi clause have אלם, transliterated Alem. The William Davidson digital Sanhedrin 64a paragraph has אלס, Alas. Rashi’s place-name interpretation is Hyman’s report; the printed Hyman and Rashi pages have not been inspected in this comparison.

The consulted digital Rashi on Sanhedrin 64a now confirms “ben Alas,” expressly with a samekh, as a place-name. Hyman’s Alem spelling and his uncertainty about the man’s scholarly status remain unchanged; no printed Rashi collation is claimed.
